rationale: With a unanimous vote and Roberts in the majority, the Chief is most likely to keep the opinion and write a narrow locus-delicti holding that venue under § 1519 lies only where the defendant’s falsification/destruction/concealment conduct occurred, rejecting investigation-situs venue as manufactured. Separate writings are most likely from Gorsuch/Thomas (text-and-structure emphasis) or Alito/Kagan (practical/workability gloss), but the Court will try to maintain a single majority rationale.
